verdict.rationale: Twenty documents a self-serve path that covers the story: cloud signup with a workspace in under a minute (twenty-gh-3), and CSV/XLSX import with in-UI field mapping, duplicate detection and inline error fixing (twenty-docs-9, twenty-docs-27, twenty-docs-37). Kanban boards provide the pipeline view (twenty-docs-34), and a community user called setup 'extremely easy' while noting small alpha-era issues (twenty-comm-1). missing for 10: no documented or hands-on evidence of the full signup-to-pipeline flow completing in under an hour, no guided onboarding or migration wizard from other CRMs, and importing relations requires preparing unique-key references (twenty-docs-28), which may slow a first migration.
